facts.fact: The course is on a peninsula between Pleasant Bay and Crows Pond in Chatham, on Cape Cod.
The quahog (hard clam) of Cape Cod's bays, whose purple shell gave wampum; chosen for the Cape setting (interpretation; the scouting's seal idea repeats Bandon Dunes' seal).

concepts.name: The Quahog
concepts.rationale: A Cape Cod quahog shell, its chalky grey growth bands and the wampum purple of its lip, on a flat of pale sand.
concepts.strengths: One subject, no background, in the house style (developer 2026-10-25: no circular badges).
